name: gke-platform-security
description: >- Plans, configures, and hardens platform-level Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster security. Covers cluster add-ons (Secret Manager enablement), RBAC hardening (disabling insecure bindings, audit tools), Binary Authorization, enabling Shielded Nodes, GKE Sandbox cluster enablement, GKE IAM roles, and cross-service authentication IAM patterns. author: google
summary_zh: 一套用于规划和加固 GKE 集群平台安全的方案，适合强化控制面、权限管理、节点隔离和跨服务身份认证。
